Applicant :- Dinesh Giri And Another
Opposite Party :- State of U.P. and Another
Counsel for Applicant :- Madan Singh

Counsel for Opposite Party :- G.A.,Vikas Narayan Rai
Hon'ble Mrs. Manju Rani Chauhan,J.
1.

Heard Mr. Madan Singh, learned counsel for the applicants, Mr. Vikas Narayan Rai, learned
counsel for opposite party no.2 as well as Mr. Rizwan Ahmad, learned A.G.A. for the State and
perused the record.

2.  This application under Section 482 Cr.P.C. has been filed to quash the charge sheet dated 01.12.2019 along with Summoning order dated 30.01.2021 and the entire proceeding of Case No.2997 of 2020, arising out of Case Crime No.1096 of 2019, under Section 498A, 323, 504, 506,
377, 307, 354 I.P.C. against applicant no.1 and Section 354, 506 I.P.C. against applicant no.2, Police Station- Kavi Nagar, District- Ghaziabad as well as stay the further proceeding of the aforesaid case,

3.

sentences.text: On 01.10.2024, the following order was passed :-

"Learned counsel for both the parties submitted that parties settled their dispute arising out of offence punishable under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 377, 307, 354 of of I.P.C. against the applicant no. 1 and under Section 354, 506 of I.P.C. against the applicant no. 2, on the basis of compromise dated 3.9.2014.
Original compromise has been annexed at page nos. 78 to 80 of the paper book.
Office is directed to send original compromise to court concerned for verification immediately after retaining a photocopy of the same.
Both the parties are directed to appear before the court concerned within three weeks from today.
Court concerned is directed to verify the same.
Applicants are directed to file supplementary affidavit annexing certified copy of the compromise as well as proceedings of verification of compromise.
Put up this case on 26.11.2024, as fresh.

Till the next date of listing, further proceedings of Case No. 2997 of 2020, arising out of Case Crime No. 1096 of 2019, under Sections 498-A, 323, 504, 506, 377, 307, 354 of of I.P.C. against the applicant no. 1 and under Section 354, 506 of I.P.C. against the applicant no. 2, P.S. Kavi Nagar, District Ghaziabad, pending in the court of Additional District Judge (FTC), Court No. 2, Ghaziabad, shall remain stayed against the applicants."
4.

entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: In compliance of the aforesaid order dated 01.10.2024, a report from Additional District and Session Judge/F.T.C. Court No.02, Ghaziabad is placed on record as is evident from office report dated 08.01.2025.

Ghaziabad dated 23.11.2024 mentioning about non appearance of opposite party no.2 on the date fixed, therefore, the compromise could not be verified, as directed by this Hon'ble Court.
5. Learned counsel for the parties submit that mutual divorce petition filed between the parties is pending.

7. In view of the above, both the parties are directed to appear before the court below along with the certified copy of this order and be permitted to file a proper compromise deed as well as an application for verification of the same.

It is expected that the trial court may fix a date for the verification of the compromise and after ensuring the presence of parties, pass an appropriate order with respect to the same in accordance with law, as expeditiously as possible, preferably within a period of two months from today.

While passing the order verifying the compromise, the concerned court shall also record the statements of the parties as to whether all the terms and conditions mentioned in the original compromise deed, so filed, have been fulfilled or not.

8. The court in that scenario will allow the parties to obtain certified copy of the order verifying the compromise deed and it will be open to the applicants to approach this Court again for quashing of the proceedings.
9. Till verification of compromise between the parties by the court concerned, no coercive action shall be taken against the applicants in the aforesaid case.
10. With the aforesaid directions, this application is finally disposed of.
